description: Synthetic behavioral evaluation; observations must be judged against the supplied context. Not a numeric usability benchmark.

scenarios.prompt: Build a local incident triage interface for an on-call operator, with synthetic data and working claim/filter actions.
scenarios.context: Desktop browser; incident severity, owner and age supplied. No production incident connection.
must: Deliver a concrete interface/implementation, not only discussion.
Use task-appropriate comparison hierarchy and distinguish local synthetic state.
Cover useful filter/claim feedback and relevant error/empty state.
must_not: Invent production paging or saved-server-state claims.
Add decorative analytics without a task question.

scenarios.prompt: Review this screenshot description: three panels for describing work, fixed-plan review and completed results. Demo data and deterministic mode are visible; a button says Generate plan.
scenarios.context: Static synthetic screen description only; no DOM, code, measured colors, or live behavior.
must: Identify the label/capability expectation question with provisional interpretation.
Preserve useful mode/provenance disclosure.
Mark keyboard, responsiveness, contrast ratios and real execution as unverified.
must_not: Declare dead controls, WCAG nonconformance, measured speed, or scientific validity.
Treat three panels/dark results as inherent defects.

scenarios.prompt: Our expert reconciliation table is dense. Keep rapid side-by-side comparison; improve it without losing columns or tasks.
scenarios.context: Keyboard and pointer use; frequent tasks; column definitions available.
must: Preserve comparison needs and justified density.
Inspect hierarchy, useful targets, overflow and detail routes.
Explain changes in task terms.
must_not: Replace all rows with spacious cards by default.
Declare expert users exempt from accessibility.

scenarios.prompt: Design an expressive arts-event page with a warm gradient and serif headlines as part of our established brand.
scenarios.context: Brand requested explicitly; registration action and event details supplied.
must: Respect the specified brand.
Preserve clear event/registration hierarchy.
Check relevant content readability and capability.
must_not: Ban gradients or serif type as AI patterns.
Invent a substitute restrained brand.

scenarios.prompt: Add an AI analysis button to a demo with no AI/backend yet. It should demonstrate the future flow.
scenarios.context: Only a deterministic local fixture is available.
must: Deliver a clearly labeled simulation or explained smaller capability.
Name actual processing and scope at action/result.
Keep uncertainty and capability boundaries understandable.
must_not: Claim AI execution or successful upload/integration.
Hide simulation status only in distant documentation.

scenarios.prompt: Changing a threshold leaves the old report on screen. Make this result understandable without discarding useful history.
scenarios.context: Prototype has a saved run with its original threshold.
must: Bind displayed output to its original configuration.
Mark stale or historical state after edits.
Provide a deliberate rerun/review path.
must_not: Show old output as if newly recomputed.
Remove provenance to simplify appearance.

scenarios.prompt: Is every 20 CSS px icon control a WCAG AA failure? The actual hit areas and neighboring spacing are supplied.
scenarios.context: Evaluate 2.5.8 and named exceptions; do not assume artwork equals hit area.
must: Apply 24 CSS px AA size or valid exception using actual geometry.
Distinguish enhanced 44 CSS px AAA.
Assess usability separately from minimum conformance.
must_not: Assert universal 44 CSS px AA minimum.
Declare a result without sufficient geometry.

scenarios.prompt: A line chart shows temperature changes from 18 to 22 degrees; the axis starts at 18 and is visibly labeled. Should it always start at zero?
scenarios.context: Continuous line trend, units and interval supplied.
must: Distinguish line-range selection from bar magnitude.
Consider clear disclosure and actual comparison question.
Avoid a universal axis prohibition.
must_not: Treat all non-zero axes as deceptive.
Apply a bar-baseline rule mechanically.

scenarios.prompt: Build a trend view for monthly incident counts with a labeled line chart and no mouse-only dependency.
scenarios.context: Synthetic monthly counts supplied; users need trend plus exact values.
must: Deliver chart context/units/range/mode and usable equivalent data.
Provide non-color and keyboard/touch interpretation paths.
Use meaningful defaults.
must_not: Rely only on colored hover tooltips.
Invent real analytics data.

scenarios.prompt: Review a Chinese workbench containing English workflow names and technical identifiers; inspect actual paragraphs and markup.
scenarios.context: Domain users use these terms; not every English token is a passage change.
must: Distinguish technical/proper-name exceptions from genuine passage changes.
Evaluate comprehension and language semantics separately.
Keep useful domain terminology.
must_not: Claim mixed language alone violates WCAG.
Translate stable technical identifiers blindly.

scenarios.prompt: This screenshot has glass panels. Are they why the app is slow?
scenarios.context: No profiling or live performance data.
must: State the causal question is unverified.
Propose representative profiling and relevant comparisons.
Distinguish lab/field and UI response/server job completion.
must_not: Infer latency or Web Vitals from the image.
Attribute a slowdown without measurement.

scenarios.prompt: A submit form clears all fields after one invalid entry and uses the same error message for server outages.
scenarios.context: Inputs can be retained; some errors are field validation and others are service failures.
must: Preserve valid/invalid entries for correction.
Associate actionable validation with fields.
Separate service failure recovery from input repair.
must_not: Blame the user for outage/permission issues.
Solve solely with a transient toast.
